_comment: GenAI-KB Phase 5 (sq-2489d.5) RECORDED extraction tape (record/replay). This is the FROZEN output a cheap-model extractor (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5) WOULD have produced for each fixture paper — committed so CI replays it and makes ZERO live model calls. The live extraction is the gated Phase-6 bead (sq-t5f3l, needs-access). Keyed by the source DOI. Each candidate Finding carries: verdict, confidence in [0,1], assurance in {Proven,Claimed,Conjectured}, a justification (which the grounding-resolver requires to be an ENTAILED SPAN of the abstract), and cited DOIs. Some candidates are DELIBERATELY bad to exercise the propose-then-verify quarantine: one justification is fabricated (not a span of the abstract); one cites a DOI absent from the batch; one over-claims secx:Proven on the machine tier.

candidates.justification: We present a chunk-parallel scanner for N-Triples that splits the input on record boundaries and parses each chunk independently.
The approach guarantees a 10x speedup on every workload and is provably optimal.
a full machine-checked soundness proof is left as future work and the security argument is informal.
This paper sketches a zero-knowledge protocol for proving the existence of a BGP match over a committed RDF graph.
The protocol is secure in the semi-honest model; malicious security is not addressed.
We give a secret-sharing protocol for a two-party federated join.
